svg.title: Signed-in checks: cookie or probe
svg.desc: - probeScript: Umbra fully loads probe (or login) so the app can refresh its tokens, then awaits the script once. The script can wait for app initialization and make a read-only authenticated request, returning a boolean. Tokens stay in the page; script exceptions, a non-boolean result or no answer within 30 seconds mean "couldn't check". A public app shell returning 200 or a stale cookie alone proves nothing. For example, "probeScript": "return (await fetch('/api/me')).ok;" checks a cookie-authenticated app. Bearer-token apps need their own authenticated request. Keep script code and site URLs trusted, and never return credentials.
